fact: Decree D/2024/177 of 13 October 2024 makes the Registre Social Unifié, run by the FDSI, the single gateway for social protection in Guinea, requires partners' interventions to be based on data extracted from it, and leaves interoperability terms to a later technical note.
title: Décret D/2024/177/PRG/CNRD/SGG du 13 octobre 2024 portant création, mission et fonctionnement du registre social unifié (RSU) en République de Guinée
